tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Satisfactory work completion certificate of one similar nature of contract for Providing Manpower services for Security and Housekeeping on outsource basis of value not less than Rs.99,50,000/- in each case, in Government of Karnataka / Government of India organizations in any one financial year in last three years i.e (2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26)

The Tenderer should have an annual financial turnover of Rs.3,98,00,000/- at least in two financial years in Providing Manpower services for Security and Housekeeping on outsource basis in last three years i.e (2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26)
